offering_description.value: Licenses photographs, video, music and illustrations to businesses and media organizations through an online platform. Content comes from its own photographers and third-party contributors, and it also offers custom creative and production work.

primary_products.value: stock images; editorial photos; stock video; music tracks

primary_services.value: creative services; custom content production; visual content curation

customer_segment.value: B2B: media companies, publishers, advertising agencies, corporate marketing teams

end_markets.value: media and publishing; advertising and marketing; corporate communications; education

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly and annual plans for image and video downloads; licensing or royalties: per-asset license fees for commercial and editorial use; service fees: custom photo, video and creative production for clients
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: online marketplace where customers search and license content; service provider: creative and production services sold to brands and media; other: aggregates content from photographers and creators, paying them royalties

geography_served.value: global: customers and offices across many countries worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: still images, editorial photos, video and music licensing

distribution_channels.value: online: website and API for self-serve customers; direct sales: enterprise and media accounts managed by sales teams; partners / resellers: distribution partners and resellers serving smaller customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: copyright, model release and data privacy rules such as GDPR

notes: A proposed merger with Shutterstock was announced in 2025 and its status may have changed since my information.
